messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up 1: we identified recurring pager churn overnight and some cross-AZ duplicate errors. Need owners, success metrics, and a safe rollout plan. Short thread to lock owners and actions.

Maya: Goals: reduce pager_count by 40% for known noisy alerts, stop cross-AZ duplicate pages, keep MTTR unchanged. Items: (A) nighttime paging policy, (B) exporter retry/backoff + verbosity, (C) signature-based dedupe with visibility, (D) quick verification dashboard.

Jordan: Ill own (A) nighttime paging policy + verification. Proposal: shift P3 to channel-only 22:30-07:00 UTC, add a 10m slip window to collapse identical alerts, and surface suppressed_count in the channel. Will draft policy and rollout notes. Target: 2026-04-01.

Rosa: I'll take (B) exporter fixes and (D) the verification dashboard. Plan: reduce exporter retry attempts from 5->3, add jittered backoff, and lower log severity for known benign messages. I'll add a Grafana panel: pager_noise_by_service (30d) with hour buckets. Target: 2026-03-30.

Vik: I'll own (C) dedupe prototype. Idea: canonical signature using blake2b(service + error.class + topframe64) so collisions are unlikely, short dedupe window=12m, and a probabilistic pass-through for the first N repeats to detect novel incidents. I'll also add counters suppressed_count and suppressed_samples for visibility. Target: 2026-04-05.

Maya: Nice split. Jordan, include a rollback and an opt-out tag so oncall can unmute an alert quickly. Rosa, add exporter-side dedupe where safe. Vik, ensure dedupe writes visible metrics and a webhook if suppression_rate > 30% in 1h.

Jordan: Draft policy snippet (WIP):
```
policy:
  window: 22:30-07:00
  route_overrides:
    severity: {P3: channel}
  collapse: 10m
  opt_out_tag: "no-night-suppress"
```
I'll add examples and a fallback to email if channel is empty.

Rosa: PromQL I'll use for the heatmap: 
```
sum by(service, hour)(increase(alerts_fired_total[30d]))
```
and verification panel query: 
```
sum by(service)(increase(alerts_fired_total[1d])) - sum by(service)(increase(alerts_suppressed_total[1d]))
```
Uploading CSV + dashboard mock to INFR-4999.

Vik: Dedupe config prototype (WIP):
```
- name: cross-az-blake-dedupe
  signature: blake2b(service,error.class,topframe:64)
  window: 12m
  passthrough_first: 2
  visibility: ["suppressed_count","suppressed_samples"]
```
I'll add unit tests and a canary rollout (10% traffic) before wider rollout.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4999 and assigned to <@Jordan> (policy) due 2026-04-01, <@Rosa> (exporter+dashboard) due 2026-03-30, <@Vik> (dedupe) due 2026-04-05. Recurring check-in scheduled: Alert Hygiene (biweekly) starting 2026-03-29 16:30 UTC.

Maya: Acceptance criteria (add to tickets): baseline_nightly_pager_count, suppressed_rate_by_alert, unique_alert_signatures, median_time_to_ack. Each ticket should include the verification query and rollback steps.

Rosa: Quick note  exporter change may shift noise to logs for a day. I'll coordinate with Support to avoid confusion and include a short note in the ticket.

Vik: For canary metrics I'll track: pages_sent_canary, pages_suppressed_canary, false_suppression_incidents. Canary will run 72h with half-hourly reporting.

Jordan: I'll prepare the policy RFC and include examples for opt-out and manual unmute. Also adding an automation to alert the oncall if suppressed_count > 50 for any alert in 1h.

Maya: Great. Ops-bot, please attach ticket links and create the calendar invite. Team: post progress in INFR-4999 and bring any blockers to the first Alert Hygiene sync. Thanks! :thumbsup:
